title: Clean and Normalize Every Existing Dataset and Station
mission: Implement all audit-driven repairs and create clean diagnostic/operational/live views for every current data family.
steps: Use canonical target labels; reconcile payload duplicates.
Daily climate: preserve Trace flag, null missing values, quarantine invalid dates, remain diagnostic.
IGRA: map documented sentinels, correct proven scaling, deduplicate POR/YTD, regenerate sounding features, remain diagnostic until latency proof.
ISD: repair wind parser from raw fields, use date-effective station metadata, rebuild pre-cutoff summaries from observations only, separate proxy and live-safe status.
TC best track: diagnostic labels only.
Radar/satellite/lightning/nowcast: normalize issue/frame/first-seen and preserve imagery/object manifests.
NCEP inventory: repair cycle/valid metadata from filenames/GRIB.
Static geospatial: derive reproducible station features.
Experiment outputs: register as research artifacts only.
acceptance: All 13 families receive explicit completed disposition
failure: Unrepairable field: set NULL/quarantine and record; never substitute fabricated values
